metadata.remarks:
Network Segmentation and Zones defines the capability to partition the institutional network into discrete trust domains and to strictly control traffic between them. Segmentation reduces blast radius, limits lateral movement, and enforces differing trust assumptions across workloads, users, and environments.

Governance and Responsibility Anchor:
This pattern is the authoritative anchor for SSPPs, standards, procedures, guidelines, and assurance related to internal network trust boundaries. Controls are scoped to segmentation sub‑capabilities to enable precise assurance of zone definition and enforcement.

components.title: Zone Definition
components.description: Definition of discrete network zones representing differing trust levels and security requirements.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Define and document network boundaries and protection domains.

components.title: Inter‑Zone Traffic
components.description: Control and restriction of network traffic crossing zone boundaries.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Enforce information flow control across network zones.
Restrict communications between zones to approved paths only.

components.title: Microsegmentation
components.description: Fine‑grained segmentation within zones to limit east‑west traffic between workloads.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Apply granular flow control to limit workload‑to‑workload communication.

components.title: Boundary Policy
components.description: Definition and enforcement of policies governing permissible communications between zones.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Establish and maintain policies governing inter‑zone network communication.
